description: Source code for the RoomMaintainer class managing chat rooms, user join/leave, notifications, and room lifecycle within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: RoomMaintainer
classes.description: Manages chat rooms, user membership, notifications, and room lifecycle within the plugin.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Allows a user to join a room, creating the room if it doesn't exist, and notifies observers.

methods.name: Exit
methods.description: Removes a user from a room, destroys the room if empty, and notifies observers.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Notifies all users in a room about a new user joining.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message to all users in a room.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink to receive room events and sends existing room info.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink from receiving room events.
